questions.title: Europe’s proposed KIDS Act and what India can learn
questions.subject: polity
questions.q: Which figure fills the blank correctly?
items: The European Commission proposes a minimum age of ______ for autonomous social media accounts and wants platforms to redesign features that encourage compulsive use.
questions.why: The report says: “The European Commission proposes a minimum age of 15 for autonomous social media accounts and wants platforms to redesign features that encourage compulsive use.”
